prompt: Editorial outdoor photograph for a hiking magazine article titled "Travelling light with outdoor kit". Outdoor kit makes good travel kit: it is light, dries fast and does not crease. The Borrowdale travel pack fits cabin luggage limits and opens like a suitcase. The Coniston merino base layer and the Grisedale wool jumper stay fresh for days. A Kirkstone silk liner keeps hostel bedding at a distance. Natural light in the green fells and lakes of northern England, realistic, candid, warm and inviting, shot on a full-frame camera. No text, no logos, no brand names.
